title: create_empty_dies passes because its input path does not exist
body:
`create_empty_dies` (`sufr/tests/cli.rs:104-110`) runs `create ../data/expected/empty.sa` and asserts failure. That path is a `.sa` file under `data/expected/` and the survey did not find it there. The empty input in the repository is `data/inputs/empty.fa` (0 bytes). The command probably fails because the file is missing, so the test does not show what the CLI does with an empty input.

Seen by reading the test and listing `data/` in the survey. The command was not run.
close_reason: Fixed in 1d4b214: the test is create_empty_input_fails, on data/inputs/empty.fa, asserting failure and an empty output file.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text: At cff9fb6 the test (`cli.rs:103-109`) passes `../data/expected/empty.sa`, which does not exist. Running `create data/inputs/empty.fa` exits 1 with "Failed to read the first two bytes. Is the file empty?". So the CLI handles an empty input, and the test never reaches that code.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: Still present on dev at 657e16d: `create_empty_dies` in `sufr/tests/cli.rs:99-101` runs `create ../data/expected/empty.sa`, which does not exist, so it passes on a missing file. `data/inputs/empty.fa` fails with "Failed to read the first two bytes".
